description_en: Creates a remediation for an existing rule
kebab_example: aliyun config create-remediation --config-rule-id cr-8a973ac2e2be00a20000 --remediation-type OOS --remediation-template-id ACS-OSS-PutBucketAcl --invoke-type MANUAL_EXECUTION --params bucketName_:_resourceId_,_regionId_:_regionId_,_permissionName_:_private --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRemediation

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the remediation. Valid values:

OOS: template-based remediation using OOS.

FC: custom remediation using FC
parameters.help_zh:
修正类型。取值：

OOS：运维编排（模板修正）。
FC：函数计算（自定义修正）
parameters.name: remediation_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the remediation template.

If `RemediationType` is set to `OOS`, set this parameter to `ACS-OSS-PutBucketAcl`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/416781.html.

If `RemediationType` is set to `FC`, set this parameter to the Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the function in Function Compute. Example: `acs:fc:cn-hangzhou:100931896542****:services/ConfigService.LATEST/functions/test-php`
parameters.help_zh:
修正模板ID。

当`RemediationType`为`OOS`时，该参数为`ACS-OSS-PutBucketAcl`。关于如何获取修正模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/416781.html。

当`RemediationType`为`FC`时，该参数为函数计算的ARN，例如：`acs:fc:cn-hangzhou:100931896542****:services/ConfigService.LATEST/functions/test-php`
parameters.name: remediation_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the remediation. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: The remediation is not executed.

AUTO_EXECUTION: The remediation is automatically executed.

MANUAL_EXECUTION: The remediation is manually executed.

NOT_CONFIG: The execution mode is not set
parameters.help_zh:
修正执行方式。取值：
NON_EXECUTION：不执行。
AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。
MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。
NOT_CONFIG：未设置
parameters.name: invoke_type

parameters.help_en:
The source of the remediation template. Valid values:

ALIYUN (default): an official template.

CUSTOM: a custom template. This value is required for custom FC remediations.

NONE: no source
parameters.help_zh:
执行修正的模板来源。取值：
ALIYUN（默认值）：官方模板。
CUSTOM：自定义模板。（自定义FC修正时需要填写此值）
NONE：无
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The remediation parameters.

For more information, see the `TemplateDefinition` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/416781.html
parameters.help_zh:
修正设置的参数。

关于如何获取修正设置的参数，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/416781.html中的参数0
parameters.name: params

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request. The `ClientToken` parameter contains only ASCII characters and must not exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
